issues.title: Core strips controlling semantics without declaring mandatory source hydration
issues.evidence: Broad records lose state_machine_ref (18 nonnull), detector_state_contract (234), entry_reference_contract/target_deadline_contract (270), sampling policies, and historical activation prohibitions. October model cores lose features/train rules and active_math_allowed, which is false for 120 preserved historical rows. definition_ref preserves a path/hash/index to original data, but neither the current core schema nor manifest expressly says these definitions must be hydrated before interpretation.
issues.impact: A consumer treating program_type=restricted_predicate_ast as a complete program can omit state, entry timing or historical-math prohibitions. execution_enabled=false prevents present execution, so this is an integration contract loss rather than evidence of platform activity.
issues.requested_change: Copy controlling fields into core, or explicitly declare core non-standalone and require hash-verified source dereference/merge for all semantics before validation or activation. Retain explicit activation prohibitions and readiness flags at core level. Include model features and canonical train-rule requirements.
